newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror reports strong rise in profits.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror reports strong rise in profits.

text.p: Times Mirror Co., the nation's second largest newspaper publisher, said Wednesday that profits rose 74 percent in the first quarter boosted by a sharp drop in newsprint prices and modest revenue growth.
The results came a day after No. 3 Knight-Ridder Inc. also reported strong profits.

Times Mirror, the Los Angeles-based publisher of the Los Angeles Times, Newsday, The Baltimore Sun and other newspapers, said net income rose to $45.2 million in the first quarter from $26 million in the 1996 period.

Earnings per share rose even more sharply, to 36 cents from 14 cents a year earlier, reflecting the company's stock buyback programme. Analysts had forecast earnings of 33 cents a share on average, according to First Call, which tracks estimates.
Times Mirror stock rose 25 cents to $54.75 in consolidated trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

Revenues fell to $773.9 million from $806.8 million due to the sale of college and scientific publishing operations. Times Mirror also publishes magazines including Popular Science and professional journals.
"Outstanding performance by our Newspaper Publishing group drove Times Mirror's first quarter results," Chairman Mark Willes said.

He cited economic strength in Los Angeles and other markets and strong ad revenue growth at all newspapers. Newsprint expense fell about 30 percent in the quarter, the company said, though that was not expected to continue.
Profits in newspapers before taxes, interest and other items jumped 81 percent.

Miami-based Knight-Ridder, publisher of the Miami Herald, Philadelphia Inquirer and 29 other daily newspapers, said on Tuesday that earnings rose to $46.4 million, or 49 cents a share, in the quarter, from $23.5 million, or 24 cents a share, in the 1996 period.

The results exclude a net gain of $128 million, or $1.36 a share, from the sale of interests in cable investments it had made with Tele-Communications Inc. Including the gain, net income was $174.7 million in the latest quarter.
